The '''Adamant Mass''', often nicknamed '''Naboo's Third Planet''', was a particularly large [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].

The planetoid was rumored to harbor a pocket of valuable, high density resources in its center. It was the center-point of the [[Ironfleck Marauders]] expeditions, they had been chipping away at the Adaman Mass for years and had yet to make any progress.
